ValidationRule.description: Project 790, Req 4: closes the "Closed Won, no proposal" gap. Blocks Closed Won or Closed Lost when no approved proposal exists (see Proposal_Approval_Required__c). Companion to Block_Send_to_OM_Without_Approval, which covers Send To Order Management.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost") ), Proposal_Approval_Required__c, NOT(Exempt_From_Proposal_Approval__c), Primary_Proposal_Status__c <> "Approved" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This opportunity cannot be closed (won or lost) without an approved proposal (Quote) on file. Create and submit a proposal for approval before closing this opportunity.
